thread:
Priya Patel: FYI customer Northstar Analytics just sent a vendor security questionnaire (SOC2 + DPA + infra access). PDF in thread. They want answers by EOD Fri. Can someone take lead on responses?

Samir Khan: I'll take the tech/security Qs. quick Q: do they require HSM-level KMS or is cloud KMS OK?

Jess Morales (Legal): We can provide our standard DPA and SOC2 bridge letter. If they need HSM we can confirm supported KMS (AWS KMS w/ CloudHSM integration). Also need to check if they want data residency guarantees.

Taylor Reed: I'll own coordinating with customer and send draft answers. @Jess Morales can you send the DPA template and the SOC2 summary I can attach?

SecurityBot: Automated checklist scan of question PDF: "requests: SOC2 Type II report, DPA, encryption in transit & at rest, KMS/HSM, data residency, deletion policies, access logs, audit trail". Score: high importance.

Samir Khan: For answers, propose short snippet for encryption: `We encrypt all customer data in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest using AES-256. Customers may use customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or GCP KMS. Private deployments support HSM integrations.` Thoughts?

Jess Morales (Legal): That phrasing is fine. Add: `We can provide a signed DPA; we also offer contractual data residency controls for Dedicated/Private deployments.`

Taylor Reed: I'll send this to Northstar and ask which region + whether they want CMK. Also will attach the SOC2 summary and DPA. Targeting to send by 3pm PT today. @Priya Patel can you confirm the customer SLA/contract status so we know negotiation flexibility?

Priya Patel: Customer is in onboarding (PO signed), on a month-to-month trial. They flagged compliance as renewal blocker. Please escalate if they ask for contractual residency. 

Samir Khan: I'll prepare the tech appendix for the questionnaire, add logs/retention details and sample API ACLs. ETA 2pm.

Taylor Reed: Great. I'll draft the cover email and bring Legal loop if they push on residency terms. :thumbsup:

Jess Morales (Legal): I'll prep the DPA + SOC2 summary bundle and send to Taylor. If they request changes, route to me.

Priya Patel: Thanks all — ping here when sent. 🙏
